name: vision-2
title: VISION-2 — a 2-bit GPU chip
description: Build VISION-2: a 2-bit-per-pixel graphics chip. It contains a framebuffer (64x32 pixels, 2 bits each = 4096 bits), a VGA-style timing generator producing HSYNC/VSYNC and pixel x/y, a pixel mux that reads the framebuffer and emits the 2-bit color per pixel, and a mode register (0=bitmap, 1=4-color text with an 8x8 font ROM). The testbench must walk a few pixels and print VISION2:PASS.
context: Pixel clock 25.175MHz nominal (use clk directly). Visible 640x480 with our 64x32 logical grid: two counters generate x (0..63) and y (0..31); HSYNC asserted during the back porch period x>=40; VSYNC during y>=20..22. Framebuffer address = y*64+x; color = fb[2:0]. Mode register selects bitmap vs text. Font ROM: 8x8, glyphs for A-Z, 0-9, truncated. Text row = y/8, col = x/8. Testbench writes pixels to the frame buffer and checks the emitted color at a couple of (x,y), then prints VISION2:PASS.

manifest.purpose: 64x32x2 framebuffer (4096 bits) + simple write port for the testbench
manifest.ports: input clk, input we, input [11:0] waddr, input [1:0] wdata, input [11:0] raddr, output [1:0] rdata

manifest.purpose: generates x,y from pixel clk and HSYNC/VSYNC pulses
manifest.ports: input clk, input rst, output reg [5:0] x, output reg [4:0] y, output reg hsync, output reg vsync

manifest.purpose: 8x8 glyph ROM for the text mode (A-Z 0-9)
manifest.ports: input [5:0] glyph, input [2:0] xo, input [2:0] yo, output bit

manifest.purpose: selects bitmap color or text-mode foreground/background from the mode register
manifest.ports: input mode, input [1:0] fb_data, input font_bit, output [1:0] rgb

manifest.purpose: top: ties timing + framebuffer + font + pixel mux; exposes hsync/vsync/rgb
manifest.ports: input clk, input rst, input mode, input we, input [11:0] waddr, input [1:0] wdata, output hsync, output vsync, output [1:0] rgb

manifest.purpose: testbench driving writes and pixels; print VISION2:PASS

criteria: runs:sh -c "cd /home/rox/work/vision-2 && iverilog -g2012 -o /tmp/vis.out vision2.v frame_buf.v timing.v font_rom.v pixel_mux.v tb_vision.v && vvp /tmp/vis.out"
